• Vitamin A is required for good vision, immune health, and normal growth and development of body tissues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question: SLR is an important tool used by RBI to control money supply in the economy. The full form of SLR is_______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the **__Statutory Liquidity Ratio.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The SLR is fixed by **the RBI**. CRR (Cash Reserve Ratio) and SLR have been the traditional tools of the central bank's monetary policy to control credit growth, the flow of liquidity, and inflation in the economy.
 
• The SLR was prescribed by Section 24 (2A) of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949.
 
• **During inflation, RBI raises SLR to control the bank credit**.
 
• SLR is a monetary policy tool that the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) uses **to assess the liquidity at the banks' disposal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Reserve Bank of India is the authority to control inflation through **monetary policies** which it does by increasing: 

 
 
• Bank rates, 
 
• Repo rates, 
 
• Cash reserve ratio, 
 
• Buying dollars, 
 
• Regulating money supply 
 
• Availability of credit.

questions.question: In November 2021, under the Atma Nirbhar Bharat Abhiyan, the Central Government has approved the SPV that would privatise the electricity distribution business in which of the following Union Territories?

• One of the key measures planned was to reform the power distribution and retail supply in UTs through privatization of the power distribution utilities, for leveraging private sector efficiency in electricity distribution.

questions.question: In which sport does the score depend on putting the ball in a hole?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Golf.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Golf** is a cross-country game in which a player strikes a small ball with various clubs from a series of starting points (teeing grounds) into a series of holes on a course.
 
• **Different Golf Scoring Formats:**
 
 
• **Stroke Play:** In this type of play, you are to take note of the strokes you’ve committed in each hole using the scorecard. At the end of the game, the player with the lowest strokes wins.
 
• **Match Play: **The difference is that a winner is defined in each hole – that is by comparing your number of strokes against your opponent’s. The player with fewer strokes wins the hole. At the end of the game, the player who won most of the holes wins.
 
• **Stableford system**: In this scoring format, which was named Dr. Stableford, what is taken into account to decide a winner is how well a player plays against his own handicap. This is done by converting under, even, and over strokes into points against par adjustment based on handicap. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hockey is a term used to denote various types of both summer and winter team sports which originated on either an outdoor field, sheet of ice, or dry floor such as in a gymnasium.
 
• Baseball is a bat-and-ball sport played between two teams of nine players each, taking turns batting and fielding. 
 
• The game is in play when a player on the fielding team, called the pitcher, throws a ball that a player on the batting team tries to hit with a bat.
 
• Squash is **a racket and ball sport played by two or four players in a four-walled court with a small, hollow rubber ball**. 
 
• The players alternate in striking the ball with their rackets onto the playable surfaces of the four walls of the court.

questions.question: Which statement is NOT correct regarding the food chain?

options.text: Every component of food chain forms trophic level.
Inter-relation between different food chains is known as a food web.
All the chains formed by nutritional relations are used to understand energy flow.
In food chain, energy level increases from lower trophic level to higher trophic level.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** In the food chain, the energy level increases from a lower trophic level to a higher trophic level.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A food chain **describes how energy and nutrients move through an ecosystem**.
 
• At the basic level, there are plants that produce the energy, then it moves up to** higher-level organisms like herbivores. **
 
• After that when carnivores eat the herbivores,** energy is transferred from one to the other.**
 
• There are** 2 types of food chains,** namely the **Grazing food chain and Detritus food chain**.
 
• Food chains are important because **they show the intricate relationships in ecosystems**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82cb466a4599894653963420b2e47c7bdf9b4d3f590068430b38de9372e73d9c.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **All of the interconnected and overlapping food chains in an ecosystem make up a food web.** Organisms in food chains are grouped into categories called** trophic levels.**
 
• The relationship between organisms is interlinked by a **food chain.** Food web: **It is the link between different food chains and presents what species eat in an ecological system**.
 
• **Energy flow** is the flow of energy through living things within an ecosystem.

questions.question: In the electronic configuration of an atom, What does ‘n’ signify in the formula 2n²?

options.text: The number of the given shell from the nucleus
The number of valence electrons present

questions.solution:
Correct answer is__** The number of the given shell from the nucleus.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **2n² **denotes the maximum number of electrons that a shell can accommodate. n refers to the **principal quantum number of the shell**.
 
• The elements have **different shells in which the electrons are present and revolve around the nucleus.**
 
• 2n square rule is used in electronic configuration. there are** K,L ,M and N shells**. firstly taking n=1 we get that in the **K shell only two electrons can be placed.**
 
• Taking **n=2** we get that in** the L shell 8 **electrons can be filled and so on.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8144e71332d21d6e4e72ac430d70105015323ea04ad926cfe47e333dd4124dc.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**The number of electrons** in a neutral atom is **equal to the number of protons**. 
 
• The number of protons in an atom is called its **atomic number (Z)**. This number is very important because **it is unique for atoms of a given element.**
 
• For neutral atoms, the number of valence electrons is **equal to the atom's main group number**.
 
• The main group number for** an element can be found from its column on the periodic table**. For example, **carbon is in group 4 and has 4 valence electrons.**
 
• **Oxygen is in group 6 and has 6 valence electrons.**

questions.question: What is the starting voltage of an AA battery used for home gadgets such as remote controls, small toys, and wireless kitchen appliances?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1.5 V.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **AA batteries** measure at **1.5V** and work well for devices that require a somewhat **high current draw** but are **not in constant use.**
 
• For example, an alkaline battery, like a** AA or AAA, has a nominal voltage** of about **1.5V**, while the voltage of a** LiPo battery** will normally be around 3.7V. The key word here is **'nominal'**, as the actual voltage of the battery will fluctuate turn on how much charge it has left.
 
• **A classic nominal voltage, most AA, AAA, C, & D cells are 1.5 volts**, and many household and handheld devices have been built to use that voltage.
 
• The first zinc-carbon dry cells naturally produced **1.5 volts of energy and have remained the standard ever since.**

• It is an enterprise taken by the World Health Organization (WHO) to **raise awareness about the overall health and well-being of people across the world. Each year, there is a specific theme for World Health Day.**

questions.question: Which is a visible sign of severe iodine deficiency?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Swelling in the neck.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Symptoms of iodine deficiency and related thyroid disorders can include **Swelling of thyroid glands in the neck**. 
 
• A visible **lump (goitre) on your neck. **
 
• **Treatment: ** It is usually treated by **eating more foods containing iodine, using iodised salt, and taking iodine supplements**.
 
• **Precautions: **You can use** small amounts of iodized salt **and eat packaged bread to** increase the amount of iodine in your diet.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Cavities, also called **tooth decay or caries,** are caused by a combination of factors, including **bacteria in your mouth, frequent snacking, sipping sugary drinks, and not cleaning your teeth well**.
 
• **Night blindness**** (nyctalopia)** is your inability to see well at night or in poor light such as in a restaurant or movie theatre.
 
• The main cause of **bleeding gums** is the **buildup of plaque at the gum line**.

questions.question: The first recipient of the National Award for Best Music Direction was _______ who was honoured for his composition in the Tamil film Kandan Karunai.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**KV Mahadevan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The first recipient of the award was **K. V.** **Mahadevan** who was honoured for his composition in the Tamil film Kandan Karunai (1967).
 
• **Krishnankoil Venkadachalam Mahadevan** (14 March 1918 – 21 June 2001) was an Indian composer, singer-songwriter, music producer, and musician known for his works in** ****Tamil cinema, Telugu cinema, Kannada cinema, and Malayalam cinema.**
 
• His music assistant known as** Puhalendi in the Telugu film industry **was with **him like a life partner throughout his life, though scored few films on his own. **

 [IMAGE: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/5/57/K.V.MahadevanImg.jpg/220px-K.V.MahadevanImg.jpg] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vidyasagar** (born 2 March 1963) is an Indian composer, musician, and singer who works predominantly in the Tamil, Malayalam, and Telugu film industries.
 
• **Devanesan Chokkalingam**, also known as Deva, is a south Indian film composer and singer who predominantly works in Tamil Cinema.

questions.question: In which of the following years did Pandit Bhimsen Gururaj Joshi give his first ever live performance?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1941.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Bhimsen** Joshi first performed live in **1941** at the age of 19.
 
• His debut album, **containing a few devotional songs in Marathi and Hindi, was released by HMV the next year in 1942.**
 
• Later Joshi moved to Mumbai in 1943 and** worked as a radio artist.**
 
• His performance at a** concert in 1946 **to celebrate his** guru Sawai Gandharva's 60th birthday won him accolades both from the audience and his guru.**

 [IMAGE: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/91/ShashankwithBhimsenJoshi.jpg/220px-ShashankwithBhimsenJoshi.jpg] 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **​**His first music teacher was **Channappa of Kurtakoti,** who had trained with the **veteran singer Inayat Khan.**
 
• Joshi heard a recording of **Abdul Karim Khan's Thumri "Piya Bin Nahi Aavat Chain" in Raga Jhinjhoti**** when he was a child, which inspired him to become a musician.**
 
• During this time, he also **heard Pandit ****Sawai Gandharva at a performance in Kundgol. In 1933, the 11-year-old Joshi left Dharwad for Bijapur**** to find a master's and learn music.**
